task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Lift the sauce can with flat bottom, then place it next to the smooth teal kitchenpot for stovetop use
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架将平底酱罐提起，然后将其放置在光滑的青色厨房锅旁边以供炉灶使用
